aviation_incidents.headline: 西南航空737-700起飛後二號發動機失效，宣布緊急狀態轉降洛杉磯
aviation_incidents.summary: 西南航空3396號班機11月6日自加州約翰韋恩機場起飛後不久失去二號發動機動力，機組宣布緊急狀態並發出7700緊急代碼，隨即轉降洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）。該班機原定由聖安娜飛往聖荷西，機型為19年機齡的波音737-700，機身編號N281WN，機上共有97人。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Southwest Airlines Boeing 737 loses No. 2 engine after takeoff, declares emergency and diverts to Los Angeles
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Southwest Airlines Flight 3396 lost power in its No. 2 engine shortly after taking off from John Wayne Airport (SNA)-Orange County on Friday, November 6, 2026, prompting the crew to declare an emergency and squawk 7700. The Boeing 737-700, registration N281WN, was operating a scheduled service from Santa Ana to Norman Y. Mineta San Jose International Airport (SJC) with 97 people on board, and diverted to Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), where it landed safely.
entities: Norman Y. Mineta San Jose International Airport (SJC)

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航前3季營收1859.4億元、每股賺1.8元，營收與淨利同創同期新高
taiwan_aviation.summary: 中華航空公告前3季財報，合併營收1859.4億元、合併營業淨利157.74億元、合併稅後淨利126.24億元、歸屬母公司淨利110.02億元、每股盈餘1.8元，前3季營收及淨利雙創歷年同期新高。第3季營收651.25億元、淨利49.29億元、每股盈餘0.72元，也寫下歷年同期新高。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines posts record first-nine-months revenue of NT$185.94 billion, EPS of NT$1.8
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines reported record first-nine-months results, with consolidated revenue of NT$185.94 billion, operating profit of NT$15.774 billion, after-tax net profit of NT$12.624 billion, net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$11.002 billion, and earnings per share of NT$1.8. Both revenue and profit set new highs for the first nine months of a year. Third-quarter revenue reached NT$65.125 billion, net profit NT$4.929 billion, and earnings per share NT$0.72, also records for a third quarter.

international_aviation.headline: 北約開設反無人機市集，16套系統供盟國免招標採購
international_aviation.summary: 北約於2026年11月5日開設反無人機市集，盟國可直接從16套預選方案的目錄下單，無需另行招標。負責管理市集的北約通訊與資訊局選定Alta Ares、Axon Enterprise、諾斯洛普格拉曼、OSL UK與Quantum Systems等5家廠商；入選系統已在盟國與烏克蘭部署，涵蓋固定式、可運輸式與機動式系統，用於保護軍事設施、關鍵基礎設施與行進中的部隊。
international_aviation.headline_en: NATO opens counter-drone marketplace with 16 systems from five companies
international_aviation.summary_en: NATO launched a counter-drone marketplace on November 5, 2026, enabling allied countries to order from a catalog of 16 preselected solutions without running a separate tender. The NATO Communications and Information Agency, which manages the marketplace, selected Alta Ares, Axon Enterprise, Northrop Grumman, OSL UK and Quantum Systems; the selected capabilities have already been deployed in allied countries and Ukraine, and include static, transportable and mobile systems to protect military installations, critical infrastructure and troops on the move.
